parameters.content:
## Instant Airtable webhook
Airtable sends the changed record ID to the production webhook. Generate Domains creates the quote immediately. Approve Purchase starts checkout immediately. The approval checkbox and 24-hour quote guard remain required. Multi-batch orders default to 10 minutes between batches (editable per request). Selected domains must pass a pairwise similarity threshold.

After checkout, Domains and Email Accounts records are linked to the client workspace. Passwords remain in Email Accounts → Login Password and are also appended as a readable domain/email/password block in Workspace IDs → Logins for the secure client portal. Both EmailGuard nodes use the existing EmailGuard Secret Relay credential. Keep workflow concurrency at 1.
